entities.name: ARX1 (Q6CKB6)
observations: Exact 571-aa sequence match to reviewed Kluyveromyces lactis ARX1 (UniProt Q6CKB6).
Probable metalloprotease implicated in proper pre-60S ribosomal particle assembly and accompanying pre-60S particles to the cytoplasm; annotation says by similarity.
Annotated as a component of nucleoplasmic and cytoplasmic pre-60S particles; localization reported in nucleus and cytoplasm.
Sequence-derived mass 63,260 Da and theoretical pI 7.16.
No explicit catalytic reaction was retrieved; Pfam analysis returned no domain results.
